title: Catherine Duke Low
dates: (b. 1814/5)
---

cousin of CMY

Known as Kate Low, she was described by CMY as in her childhood \'a grown up young lady beyond my horizon\'. She married briefly (28 July 1864) Rev. Henry Low, Dean of Exeter College, Oxford (1808/9-18 Nov 1864) [PB 1914 Crawley Boevey; Alumni Oxonienses; 1871 census Tyntesfield 1881 census Bath; 1851 and 1861 censuses in Bath with aunts Susanna and Elizabeth Crawley]
